description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Varus''' fires a hail of arrows at the target location that land after 0.5 seconds, dealing physical damage to enemies hit.
description.text: Active: Varus fires a hail of arrows at the target location that land after 0.5 seconds, dealing physical damage to enemies hit.

description2.raw: The area then becomes desecrated for 4 seconds, [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] enemies within and inflicting them with [[File:Grievous Wounds icon.png|20px|link=Grievous Wounds|An icon representing the keyword Grievous wounds]] [[:Grievous Wounds|Grievous Wounds]].
description2.text: The area then becomes desecrated for 4 seconds, slowing enemies within and inflicting them with Grievous Wounds.

leveling.raw:
'''Physical Damage:'''
60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 (+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)

notes.raw: * [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|Slow]] lingers for 0.25 seconds after leaving the marked area. * ''Hail of Arrows'' consumes [[File:Varus Blighted Quiver.png|20xpx|border|link=Varus#Blighted Quiver|An icon for Varus's ability Blighted Quiver]] [[Varus#Blighted Quiver|Blighted Quiver]] stacks for bonus damage a second time after ~0.3 seconds of hitting, allowing stacks applied during this time to be triggered.
notes.text:
Slow lingers for 0.25 seconds after leaving the marked area.
Hail of Arrows consumes Blighted Quiver stacks for bonus damage a second time after ~0.3 seconds of hitting, allowing stacks applied during this time to be triggered.
